District Rural Development Agency Office, Khagaria

content_sections.heading: DRDA Khagaria Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DRDA Khagaria notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation in any subject from a recognised institution; Good working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Canva, Internet, E-mail and web resources; Knowledge of management coordination, documentation and communication skills; Good command of English, Hindi and the regional language Experience: Minimum 2 years' work experience in education and public awareness programmes related to cleanliness campaign, water bodies, pollution control, sanitation and youth awareness/activism Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 1 June 2026) Other conditions: Good working knowledge of MS Office and web resources (Technical Qualification) Knowledge of management coordination, documentation and communication skills Good command of English, Hindi and the regional language Desirable: Honours degree in Environmental Science and other courses specified by the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) Local candidates with experience in the related field and a good / excellent academic record

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract period maximum 3 years, renewed each year for one year Renewal by SMCG if found satisfactory on the DGCS annual performance evaluation report Appointment may be cancelled at any time without prior notice if not required or if the programme is closed Post is purely contractual and confers no claim to regular or permanent employment

content_sections.heading: How Will DRDA Khagaria Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list prepared on the criteria at serial 1 to 8 of the qualification table Shortlisting of eligible candidates Efficiency test / Interview Merit list on the criteria at serial 1 to 8 of the qualification table Shortlisted candidates informed at least 5 days before the efficiency test / interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Signed application form in the prescribed format with photograph Self-attested copies of all certificates mentioned in the application form Marksheets and certificates At interview: originals of all documents with two photocopies At interview: two passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDA Khagaria Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notice. Sign the form and attach all enclosures such as marksheets and certificates (self-attested copies). Send it only by registered post to District Rural Development Agency, Khagaria. Applications are accepted from 17-11-2026 to 01-12-2026 (05:00 PM); later applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the fixed period will not be considered Final decision on any dispute in the appointment process rests with the District Magistrate, Khagaria, binding on all applicants

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of District Rural Development Agency, Khagaria, dated 10 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DRDA Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DRDA Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for District Project Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DRDA Khagaria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form attached to the notice (pages 3-4); notice with form to be uploaded on the Khagaria NIC portal) and send it to District Rural Development Agency Office, Khagaria, by registered post only, to reach by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 1 June 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs. 36,000 per month plus Establishment Rs. 2,500, TA/DA Rs. 2,000 and Mobile and communication Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation in any subject from a recognised institution, minimum 2 years' experience in education and public awareness programmes on cleanliness, water bodies, pollution control, sanitation and youth awareness, and good working knowledge of MS Office and web resources.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Good working knowledge of MS Office and web resources (Technical Qualification). Knowledge of management coordination, documentation and communication skills. Good command of English, Hindi and the regional language.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared on the criteria at serial 1 to 8 of the qualification table. Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Efficiency test / Interview. Merit list on the criteria at serial 1 to 8 of the qualification table.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract period maximum 3 years, renewed each year for one year. Renewal by SMCG if found satisfactory on the DGCS annual performance evaluation report. Appointment may be cancelled at any time without prior notice if not required or if the programme is closed.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Khagaria district, Bihar.
